enriched_activities.desc: Remain lying in bed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Sleep. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back over body. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Dry face. Dry hands. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check contents. Walk out of bedroom.

Sit on bed. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press power button. Unlock screen. Tap on news app. Scroll through articles. Tap on article. Read article. Scroll down. Tap back button. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like a post. Comment on a post. Close app. Lock phone. Place phone on nightstand. Stand up.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for time. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Attend meeting in conference room. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Organize files. Write reports. Attend another meeting. Eat lunch at desk. Continue working on computer. Print documents. Attend a briefing. Update database. Prepare materials for program. Talk to colleagues. Leave office.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Walk to kitchen.

Walk into kitchen. Greet Member 2: 'Hi, what can I do to help?' Wash hands. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Stir pot. Add spices. Taste food. Set table. Place plates. Place utensils. Place glasses. Fill glasses with water. Talk to Member 2. Pick up pot. Pour food into serving dish. Place dish on table.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take food from serving dish. Put food in mouth. Chew. Swallow. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put glass down. Talk to Member 2. Pick up fork again. Take more food. Eat. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Put napkin down. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Collect plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap to sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Wash fork. Rinse fork. Place fork in dish rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in dish rack. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry hands. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe table. Put away leftover food in refrigerator. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Flip through channels. Stop on a show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Watch TV. Pick up remote again. Change channel. Watch TV. Stretch arms. Yawn. Watch TV.

Sit on sofa next to Member 2. Pick up remote. Change channel. Talk to Member 2. Laugh. Watch TV. Pick up snack from bowl. Eat snack. Put snack down. Talk to Member 2. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Lean on Member 2. Watch TV.

Turn off TV. Put remote on table. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to kitchen. Pour glass of water. Drink water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put book down. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open reading app. Scroll through book list. Select book. Read pages. Tap to turn page. Read more. Close app. Lock phone. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
